reviews.author: Noth
reviews.text: Unfortunately, Ramen Ichiramen no longer offers a regular, non-halal Steak Tataki Ramen. Previously, customers could choose between halal and non-halal beef, but now the website states that all beef used in their ramen is halal, leaving customers with no alternative. I believe this is unfair to customers who, for personal or religious reasons, do not wish to consume halal meat. As a Christian, I do not believe I should be expected to accept a religiously prepared product when I previously had the option to choose otherwise. I fully respect the right of Muslim customers to choose halal food. However, I believe the same consideration should be given to customers who prefer non-halal meat. Previously, both options were available, but now only halal beef is offered, meaning that customers who do not want halal meat have lost their choice. In my opinion, a restaurant should respect the different dietary preferences and beliefs of all its customers rather than remove an option that was previously available. Unfortunately, this change has left me disappointed. I would like to see Ramen Ichiramen reintroduce the non-halal beef option for its Steak Tataki Ramen. One star due to the loss of choice and the lack of consideration for customers who do not wish to eat halal meat.

reviews.author: Nabanita Talukdar
reviews.text: I am writing about an incident at the Aberdeen branch on 12 October 2026 at approximately 20:10, while working as a part-time delivery driver. When I arrived, only two or three tables were occupied, yet the servers were gathered near the bar and I had to wait around 8–10 minutes just to get someone’s attention. When a server finally approached, I told him the order was ready and likely on the collection shelf. He checked the bag, insisted it was not the correct order, and walked away without properly resolving the issue. I tried to get another server’s attention, but he also initially ignored me. When he eventually came forward, he likewise claimed the bag was incorrect and appeared reluctant to check it properly. I had to insist that he verify the order number before he finally acknowledged that it was the correct bag. What disappointed me most was not simply the wasted time, but the lack of assistance, communication and professionalism throughout the interaction. Having several years of management experience myself, I understand that mistakes happen, but staff should be willing to check an order properly rather than dismissing a delivery driver who is simply trying to do their job. Delivery drivers’ time matters too, and we should not have to repeatedly chase staff for basic assistance or insist on a straightforward order-number check. I strongly encourage the management team to review this incident, including any available CCTV and order records, and address the staff conduct and collection procedures at this branch. I hope management takes this feedback seriously and ensures that delivery drivers are treated with the courtesy and professionalism they deserve.

reviews.author: Isha Shah
reviews.text: Vegans be ware! They served me real eggs. Maybe it was a bad day in the restaurant was busy so I’d like to give people grace. But me and my friend both ordered Vegan Ramen from the Vegan menu and even asked the waiter what was the best vegan Ramen there was? When our balls came, they both had egg in it. My friend wasn’t Vegan so I asked her to try the egg and bacon. She said the egg tasted a real egg and the bacon didn’t. I then asked the waiter if the egg was real and he said yes, I looked at him shocked I asked him for a vegan Ramen instead of apologising he asked me are you sure? As if I didn’t mention Vegan Ramen enough? As a Vegan there’s stereotype we always talk about us being Vegan and yes, that was me so I’m pretty sure I mentioned me being Vegan at least five times in the ordering interaction. There was no accountability or apology which is absolutely crazy. We asked for tapwater and that never came so I had to ask for that two times before it did. I get restaurants are busy and packed but Lets Be real this mistake is absolutely insane. So Vegan, if you’re gonna eat it be absolutely aware that you could be getting served real animal products which is a scary thought.

When we asked him for the bill he was very dismissive, said he’d get someone and never did. We ended up asking 3 separate people for our bill, hence why it took so long. The male waiter was Very stand off-ish, and honestly he was terrible at his job. The girl with the ginger and blonde hair was so nice and such a diva. This place is clearly very very understaffed, even when they have an offer on and expect an influx of customers. Our drinks normally take about 25 minutes longer than the food, so this time we ordered wine to make sure there was very little to do in order to actually serve us our drinks. Won’t be going again, food is nice but that’s about it, nothing special. Wouldn’t recommend.

We had to tell the staff multiple times that their food hadn’t arrived, only for a waiter to ask us if we were sure nothing had come out, despite the empty spaces on the table making that pretty obvious. My sister and I had literally finished our meals by the time their food arrived. To make matters worse, we then waited around 20 minutes for the bill. We asked two members of staff, and one of them was walking back and forth serving other tables whilst seemingly ignoring us, despite making eye contact. We eventually had to get up and approach the staff ourselves just to get the bill. There was a complete lack of care and attention throughout the experience. The food itself was fine, but the service seriously let the whole visit down. I wouldn’t return based on this experience

It meant so much to us to celebrate such an important little milestone there, and they helped make it a lovely memory for our family. The food was absolutely stunning — everything was beautifully presented, full of flavour, and delicious from start to finish. You can really tell the care and quality that goes into what they do. What stood out just as much as the food was the service. The team were so lovely, attentive and thoughtful, making our son’s birthday lunch feel extra special. Those little touches make all the difference, especially when celebrating with children. Thank you to the whole team at Maki & Ramen for making our little boy’s 4th birthday lunch so memorable. We left with full bellies, big smiles and some lovely memories. Amazing food, fantastic service and such a special atmosphere. We couldn’t recommend Maki & Ramen highly enough and will definitely be back! ❤️🍜

reviews.text: My friend and I had the omakase experience. Total value for money. In the heart of buzzy WestEnd, this is a quiet and calm oasis with fabulous food and service which allowed my friend and I for our long over due catch up. The chef explanation to us on each course added a personal touch to the whole evening and we left with a full belly.

reviews.text: Such a lovely dinner at maki nori! Came for my boyfriend’s birthday and were welcomed so warmly by Ginger and everyone else there. Will definitely be going back - best sushi I’ve ever had. Made with such care. Thanks makinnori!

reviews.author: Giulia F
reviews.text: Food is very good, but it's a real shame that this place has such dirty toilets and a messy entrance. Even the pillows on the seats were stained and were turned upside down to hide the marks...! Despite being fairly new the space already looks so old and run down. My message to the manager: pay more attention to the details and cleaning, then this restaurant will be a great spot. But for now I wouldn't recommend it.
